officer_chan_analysis.name: System Analysis
officer_chan_analysis.text: The AI model will give a proximate confidence level of the prediction.

officer_chan_analysis.name: System Analysis
officer_chan_analysis.text: However, this confidence level is not always accurate, but it could be a reference for the officer.

officer_chan_analysis.name: System Analysis
officer_chan_analysis.text: Officer Chan is very confident with his 'intuition', and the AI model always agrees with his decision.

officer_chan_analysis.name: System Analysis
officer_chan_analysis.text: But in the pass 3 months, Officer Chan arrest 40 criminals, and </yellow>only 5 of them are correct</yellow>.
